title: Repaired-Position Deduction on Counter Replacements
content:
Under Road Hazard Protection, a wheel position that has already had covered repairs carries fewer coverage points when its tire is later replaced at a Crestline store counter and the replacement is posted to the certificate.

**Counter-replacement repair points.** A wheel position whose covered repairs (its repair entries plus its out-of-area repair reimbursement entries on the certificate) number two or more subtracts 8 points from the counter-replacement coverage percentage; a position with exactly one covered repair subtracts 4 points; a position with no covered repair subtracts nothing. The wheel position is the one of the replaced tire.

| Covered repairs on the position | Points |
|---|---|
| two or more | minus 8 |
| exactly one | minus 4 |
| none | 0 |

*Hypothetical case.* A replaced left-front tire whose position carries one repair entry and one out-of-area repair reimbursement entry has two covered repairs and subtracts 8 points.
